title: Runtime and model compatibility matrix, v1alpha1
description: Which serving runtimes accept which model artifact formats, and which runtime and model pairs this project has actually executed. A combination that is absent from this file is unsupported until it is added here with evidence; the validator refuses it rather than assuming it works. This file records artifact-format compatibility, which is a necessary condition, not a sufficient one: a pair that appears compatible here may still fail on memory, quantisation, or architecture support.

runtimes.name: llama.cpp llama-server
runtimes.notes: GGUF is the format this runtime loads. It does not read safetensors or PyTorch checkpoints without a conversion step, and a conversion step produces a different artifact with a different hash, so it would be a different contract.

runtimes.name: vLLM, CPU backend
runtimes.notes: Recorded in ADR 0002 as the fallback and never executed by this project. The formats listed are the ones vLLM loads directly; its experimental GGUF path is deliberately not listed, because this project has run no trial that would let it claim that path works.

runtimes.name: Deterministic fixture replayer
runtimes.notes: Loads no model artifact at all. A mock-llm workload declares no runtime image and no model artifact, so no entry in this matrix applies to it.

executedPairs.evidenceClass: local real runtime, one Windows host
